text_block_list.text: Today is that special day filled with sweet aromas... Valentine's Day. On such a day—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Burdock root is seriously such a pain~~!
Like, why is there so much prep work to do?!

I was making nutritious pork miso soup
with Fusaichi Pandora.
As for how things ended up like this—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer!
Free today?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, I wanna practice making nutrient-packed tonjiru, so keep me company♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I wanted Ai-chan to try these,
so I went ahead and bought a bunch of stuff~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, I looked into it, and burdock root, bamboo shoots,
taro potatoes... they need waaay too much prep work, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, doing this alone is such a drag...
I started getting all anxious~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
C'mooon, pleeease! ♡ Do it with me!
Trainer, you're used to this kind of stuff, right?
And that was how it went.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No, but even two is too many!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I shouldn't have tried to act cool, I should've just bought prepped ingredients~!
There's so much, it's way too much, waah~!
choice_data_list: But you want it loaded with lots of ingredients, right?
But you want it loaded with lots of ingredients, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's... well. It's more nutritious that way,
and I waaaant you to get lots of nutrition...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...By the way?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you used to make things like this
for me all the time, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Pretty amazing, right? You did great.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like... that's totally true love, isn't it?
Ehehe!
After that, once I finished prepping all the vegetables and took out a pot to start boiling them...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Wait!!
There's no pork left!!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, I totally forgot to buy it! Nooo, what do I do~!?
Hey Trainer, go buy it for me!
choice_data_list: You should... go buy that yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aww, come on, I'm making side dishes! Like spinach ohitashi and stuff♡

After that, one thing led to another and I was talked into
running to the nearby supermarket to buy some pork.

And right when I safely secured the pork
and returned to the Trainer's office...
(KABLAM!!)
From inside, there came the sound of an explosion—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I wanted it to be a surprise, darn it~~~!!
Looking around, there was a smoking microwave and splattered ingredients. And drifting through the air—the sweet aroma of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...It's true that I wanted to practice making nutritious meals!
...But that wasn't the main reason.
The main reason was to surprise you, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's Valentine's Day, right?
The day to give chocolate, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you're always working so hard for me, so I just wanted to say thank you~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I 'forgot' the pork on purpose
and tried to bake a chocolate cake instead..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...? The recipe and ingredients
I prepped were all totally perfect, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: But just now, I finally realized... just how much hard work you've put in for me this whole time, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "A plain old chocolate cake feels kinda lacking, don'tcha think?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Let's make it even bigger and bolder! Super sparkly and flashy~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And while I was rushing through everything,
something... blew up...!

I was a bit surprised...
but her feelings make me truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Still, it already blew up,
so chocolate cake might be impossible...

—Scooping up a spoonful of the steaming chocolate
and butter mixture from the microwave,
I gave it a taste.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: What are you doiiing?!

"...It's separated a bit,
but it's still within recoverable range."
choice_data_list: No, it's delicious. It's still good!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way, that can't be true!
After an explosion like that?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait, and then, and then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? ...For real, you can still eat more?
Is it good? Really?"

Timidly, Fusaichi Pandora took a single scoop
with her spoon—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ......Huh? Whuuut?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're actually really good at this, seriously!! Yayyy♡
After that, the two of us baked another chocolate cake together and relished the freshly made treat.
I suggested to her that we clean up first for now, and then remake the chocolate cake together afterward.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Sure, that way there's less chance of messing up, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Still, wouldn't that make it pointless?
*I* want to give it to you!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, like... I just messed up a tiny bit,
I'm totally a prodigy normally!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I definitely won't fail next time!
So Trainer, just sit back and watch!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Dammit...! This time for real, stay calm and take it nice and careful...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Umm, sift the flour thoroughly, and melt the chocolate gently in a hot water bath! No microwaving!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Don't burn the butter, just let it melt slowly...
There we go!"
With skilled hands moving so carefully and delicately that you'd never guess she hated prepping vegetables, she kneaded the dough expertly—
Before long, a truly delicious-looking chocolate cake was complete!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Into the box you go!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright! All dooone♡
Thanks for waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks as always ☆
Let's keep doing our best together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm countin' on ya♡
Happy Valentine's♡
The chocolate cake was still slightly warm, sweet, soft, and had a gentle flavor.
